thread:
liam: deploybot just flagged SBOM / vuln noise on rc-2026-b during the 09:00-11:00 PT change window. need a delegated approver so we don't block the canary. @tara @oscar please advise.

deploybot: SCAN rc-2026-b:
- critical: 0
- high: 0
- medium: 1 (transitive lib-bar@0.9.1)
- low: 4 (license tag noise)
Gate: manual approval required. SBOM: https://artifacts/internal/rc-2026-b/sbom/diff

tara: Can infra-oncall approve license-only / low items during the window? Proposal: infra-oncall may approve up to 5 low-license flags per artifact if the licenses are on the procurement whitelist and there are no functional/test failures. :ok_hand:

oscar: fine with delegation as long as we record `approved_via:oncall`, artifact SHA, and an `approval_evidence` link (SBOM diff). No blind approvals; oncall must paste the evidence in this thread.

rachel: Security: medium transitive needs CVSS and exploitability check. If CVSS < 6 and no exploitability evidence, we can allow with a documented mitigation + 2h canary guard. If CVSS >= 6 or exploitability present -> Security review required and rollback plan.

security-bot: CVSS lookup lib-bar@0.9.1 -> 5.4 (exploitability: low). Recommendation: allow with mitigation ticket INF-4321 and monitor canary for 2 hours.

liam: decision summary: 1) Allow medium transitive lib-bar@0.9.1 because CVSS 5.4 with mitigation. 2) Delegate infra-oncall to approve low license noise during 09:00-11:00 PT. 3) Require deploybot to attach approval metadata to artifact manifest: `approved_by`, `approval_method`, `approval_evidence`, `approval_ts`, `mitigation_ticket`, `canary_guard_hours`, `rollback_condition`.

deploybot: will add the following fields to artifact manifest. example: 
```
approved_by: "tara-oncall"
approval_method: "infra-oncall-delegation"
approval_evidence: "https://artifacts/internal/rc-2026-b/sbom/diff"
approval_ts: "2026-07-12T09:02:10Z"
mitigation_ticket: "INF-4321"
canary_guard_hours: "2"
rollback_condition: "cvss>=6 || canary_alerts==true"
```
(also emits a single `release_note_line` for changelog ingestion)

oscar: add a succinct `release_note_line` format, e.g.:
`rc-2026-b: infra-oncall delegated approval for low license noise; medium transitive lib-bar@0.9.1 allowed with mitigation INF-4321; canary 2h.`

liam: i'll update the release checklist + ping PMs. oncall: when you approve, paste the artifact SHA + evidence link in this thread.

tara: approved via oncall UI. artifact sha: sha256:abcd1234ef567890... evidence: https://artifacts/internal/rc-2026-b/sbom/diff (matches manifest). approval_ts: 2026-07-12T09:03:22Z

rachel: Security monitoring hooks created for lib-bar telemetry. we'll alert if anomaly in call patterns.

liam: starting canary in 5. will post canary link here. :rocket:

deploybot: CANARY STARTED rc-2026-b at 2026-07-12T09:15:00Z. canary metrics: https://metrics/internal/canary/rc-2026-b

deploybot: CANARY PASSED at 2026-07-12T11:25:30Z. no regressions and no security alerts. promoting artifact and emitting changelog line.

oscar: copy of emitted changelog_line: `rc-2026-b: delegated infra-oncall approval for low license noise; medium transitive allowed with mitigation INF-4321.`

liam: thanks everyone. closing the loop: artifact promoted and metadata recorded for audit. if anyone needs the full trace, `deploybot show-manifest rc-2026-b` returns the approval fields.
